Payment Processing (Fintech).heading: Payment Processing (Fintech)
Payment Processing (Fintech).text:
We have our own web-based payment processing system for check clearing used in central banks, financial institutions and payment system providers. This image-based check truncation system (CTS) is similar to the one used in the United States of America, under the CHECK21 standards. Our CTS systems are sold in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Myanmar, Thailand, Pakistan, Bangladesh and in Saudi Arabia. INCHEQS (trademark pending) is our flagship Fintech product, through which we automate the clearing of checks, a payment instrument, for banks and central banks that either issue or collect checks, or both. INCHEQS is a check image-based solution where we deploy AI to identify the check amount, payee name, date, Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) code and signature to automate the approval and subsequent payment of checks to the customer. INCHEQS can be deployed at banks and clearing houses. The solution utilizes a web-based architecture and is sold either as a perpetual license with an annual maintenance contract or on an annual subscription basis. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, INCHEQS generated approximately 41% of our revenue.

INGateway is a payment gateway solution that is designed to support and be compatible with the ISO20022 messaging standards for central banks and financial institutions.

Regulatory Technology (RegTech).text:
INReport is a RegTech system which conforms to XBRL reporting standards and other compliance reporting required by regulatory agencies such as central banks, securities commissions, tax authorities and company registries. Our INReport reporting platform covers financial statistic reporting, credit risk exposure and analysis, risk management reports, Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and EU Common Reporting Standard (CRS) reporting, external sector reporting, Goods and Services Tax (GST) reporting for reporting entities and lately e-Invoicing reporting for large corporations. We have more than 54 financial institutions and 61 large corporations using this RegTech platform. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, INReport generated approximately 42% of our revenue.

Additionally, we have developed TellUS Report, a RegTech Software as a Service (SaaS) solution for public listed companies and financial institutions for Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) compliant reporting and consultancy. ESG guidelines have already been issued by Bank Negara Malaysia, the central bank of Malaysia and Bursa Malaysia Stock Exchange for their members to reduce their carbon footprint. Our subsidiary, TellUS Report Sdn Bhd, was created to focus on this new line of business in both the consultancy and reporting.

Robotic Process Automation (RPA).heading: Robotic Process Automation (RPA)

prov.heading: Credit losses
prov.text:
The Company estimates and records a provision for its current expected credit losses related to its financial instruments, including its trade receivables. Management considers historical collection rates, the current financial status of the Company’s customers, macroeconomic factors, and other industry-specific factors when evaluating current expected credit losses. Forward-looking information is also considered in the evaluation of current expected credit losses. However, because of the short time to the expected receipt of accounts receivable, management believes that the carrying value, net of expected losses, approximates fair value and therefore, relies more on historical and current analysis of such financial instruments, including its trade receivables.

Credit loss rate is determined by historical collection based on aging schedule, adjusted for current conditions using reasonable and supportable forecasts. Based on the aging categorization and the adjusted loss rate per category, an allowance for credit losses is calculated by multiplying the adjusted loss rate with the amortized cost in the respective age category.

In July 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-05, Financial Instruments—Credit Losses (Topic 326), which introduces a practical expedient for measuring expected credit losses on trade receivables and contract assets.

Regulatory Technology (RegTech).heading: Regulatory Technology (RegTech)
Regulatory Technology (RegTech).text:
INReport is a RegTech system which conforms to XBRL reporting standards and other compliance reporting required by regulatory agencies such as central banks, securities commissions, tax authorities and company registries. Our INReport reporting platform covers financial statistic reporting, credit risk exposure and analysis, risk management reports, Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and EU Common Reporting Standard (CRS) reporting, external sector reporting, Goods and Services Tax (GST) reporting for reporting entities and lately e-Invoicing reporting for large corporations. We have more than 54 financial institutions and 61 large corporations using this RegTech platform. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, INReport generated approximately 46% of our revenue.

Additionally, we have developed TellUS Report, a RegTech Software as a Service (SaaS) solution for public listed companies and financial institutions for Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) compliant reporting and consultancy. ESG guidelines have already been issued by Bank Negara Malaysia, the central bank of Malaysia and Bursa Malaysia Stock Exchange for their members to reduce their carbon footprint. Our subsidiary, TellUS Report Sdn Bhd, was created to focus on this new line of business in both the consultancy and reporting.

Payment Processing (Fintech).heading: Payment Processing (Fintech)
Payment Processing (Fintech).text:
We have our own web-based payment processing system for check clearing used in central banks, financial institutions and payment system providers. This image-based check truncation system (CTS) is similar to the one used in the United States of America, under the CHECK21 standards. Our CTS systems are sold in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Myanmar, Thailand, Pakistan, Bangladesh and in Saudi Arabia. INCHEQS (trademark pending) is our flagship Fintech product, through which we automate the clearing of checks, a payment instrument, for banks and central banks that either issue or collect checks, or both. INCHEQS is a check image-based solution where we deploy AI to identify the check amount, payee name, date, Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) code and signature to automate the approval and subsequent payment of checks to the customer. INCHEQS can be deployed at banks and clearing houses. The solution utilizes a web-based architecture and is sold either as a perpetual license with an annual maintenance contract or on an annual subscription basis. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, INCHEQS generated approximately 38% of our revenue.

INGateway is a payment gateway solution that is designed to support and be compatible with the ISO20022 messaging standards for central banks and financial institutions.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
